whole_expression.confidence: moderate; substantive coordinated revision expressly considered
whole_expression.reason: The full independently old prayer already makes God the one who increased his Church through this bishop’s apostolic care and zeal, then petitions for ever-new growth in faith and holiness. That entire action-to-growth relationship and complete final verbal petition remain. Removing the intercessory clause shortens rather than supplies an extended new prayer; naming the consecrated people makes explicit the human beneficiary; truth for religion changes the zeal’s object within the inherited means clause. Considered together, these changes are a conventional focused restatement of one actual old whole prayer. I find the exact fresh study-English unit defensible under1(6).
whole_expression.contrary_argument_weighed: The reform coordinated several purposeful theological choices: saintly merits disappear, religious zeal becomes truth-directed zeal, and an implicit Church subject becomes the consecrated people. Selection and arrangement may matter even when individual phrases are common. I therefore reject a mere name/synonym/minor-edit rationale. The affirmative decision instead relies on the already-old specific Church-increase and faith/holiness-growth architecture, the absence of a new narrative or metaphor, and the limited ordinary restatement within it. The possibility of originality remains the ambiguity explicitly accepted under repository1(6); no categorical public-domain declaration follows.
